gh pr create \
  --title "feat(studio): prevent duplicate fragment titles on clone" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Introduces a uniqueness check for Fragment Title scoped to the tag path when a card is cloned
- Automatically appends a numeric suffix (`-1`, `-2`, etc.) to the title when a duplicate is detected
- Deduplication triggers on clone flow without modifying the original card or blocking manual title edits

## Issue
Closes #11

## Test plan
- [ ] `just health` passes for all services
- [ ] `just test` passes
- [ ] Manual smoke test of changed functionality
- [ ] Cloning a card with an existing Fragment Title generates a new unique title with a `-N` suffix
- [ ] The suffix increments correctly if multiple clones already exist (e.g. `-1`, `-2`, `-3`)
- [ ] Uniqueness is scoped to the tag path, not globally
- [ ] The original card's Fragment Title is not modified
- [ ] No two cards share the same Fragment Title + Path combination after a clone operation
EOF
)" \
  --base stage
